summary.headline: Locate device navigation now targets Devices and All devices
summary.summary: The Locate device procedure replaces generic portal and relative RBAC references with direct Devices and All devices links plus direct Custom role, Help Desk Operator, and School Administrator links.
summary.adminImpact: No locate permission changed; operators still need the listed remote-task and managed-device permissions.

summary.headline: Logout current user navigation now targets Devices and All devices
summary.summary: The shared-device logout procedure now links directly to the Devices and All devices pages and to Help Desk Operator and custom-role definitions.
summary.adminImpact: No logout permission changed; retain Remote tasks/Manage shared device users and device visibility permissions.

summary.headline: Lost Mode procedures now use direct device-navigation links
summary.summary: Both enable and disable Lost Mode steps now link directly to Devices and All devices, with direct Help Desk Operator, School Administrator, and custom-role references.
summary.adminImpact: No Lost Mode permission changed; retain Enable/Disable lost mode and managed-device visibility permissions.

summary.headline: Pause Config Refresh navigation and role links are direct
summary.summary: The procedure now links directly to Devices and All devices and names Intune Administrator and custom-role destinations; its 1,440-minute maximum remains documented.
summary.adminImpact: No pause limit changed; retain Remote tasks/Run Pause Configuration Refresh permission.

summary.headline: Play Lost Mode sound procedure uses direct navigation links
summary.summary: The supervised-device sound procedure now links directly to Devices and All devices and to Help Desk Operator, School Administrator, and custom-role definitions.
summary.adminImpact: No sound permission changed; retain Remote tasks/Play sound to locate lost devices.
